temporal_continuity.rule: obs[t+1] == next_obs[t] for t=0..T-2, bitwise in float32

action_alignment_replay.method: gym.make('Pusher-v5'); reset(seed=episode_seed); at each t compare simulated obs[t] (float32) with stored obs[t]; rebuild the original float64 action via the deterministic collection policy + policy_rng_seed = (reset_seed ^ 0x5BD1E995) & 0x7FFFFFFF, then env.step(a64).

action_alignment_replay_diagnostic_float.method: gym.make('Pusher-v5'); reset(seed=episode_seed); at each t compare simulated obs[t] (float32) with stored obs[t]; env.step(stored float32 action[t]) directly.

action_distribution.note: step-to-step change > 0 confirms actions are not constant

ood_test_caveat: ood_test differs from train only by reset seed; there is NO explicit distribution-shift mechanism. It must be treated as an additional held-out test set, NOT as evidence of OOD generalisation.
frozen_test_policy: quarantined: Phase 0/3 never train on frozen_test
